experience_items.summary: Full stack with a backend focus on a multi-tenant SaaS corporate learning platform (LMS). Promoted to mid-level during the Fleeg to Twygo transition.
highlights: Resolved P0 incidents monitored in Datadog, such as a 52s P99 on user activation caused by hot-row contention on a counter cache — fixed by moving the work to background jobs.
Led technical planning for the Learning Journeys module: broke the scope into deliverables, planned the team's work and mentored a junior developer.
Built cross-organization content sharing with Sidekiq sync and trigger-based auditing, plus AI-assisted course creation with real-time updates over WebSocket.
Hardened authentication (single session per organization, token rotation, SSO/SAML enrollment rules) and fixed 230+ production bugs as level-2 support.
experience_items.tech: Ruby on Rails · MySQL · Sidekiq · SQS · React · TypeScript · RSpec · AWS · Datadog

experience_items.summary: B2B SaaS sales and marketing CRM, from the backend to integrations and UI.
highlights: Refactored the marketing and sales automation engine to fix slowness: bulk inserts, batch processing, N+1 removal, a repositories layer and unique indexes.
Evolved the two-way integration with the Omie ERP (leads, customers, sellers, products and sales cycle driven by invoicing).
Implemented the account lifecycle, with an audited async deletion pipeline that removed about 12k companies created by bots.
Hardened security with CSP, HSTS, rate limiting and Redis locks against concurrency in the leads API.
experience_items.tech: Ruby on Rails · PostgreSQL · Sidekiq · Redis · RSpec · AWS

experience_items.summary: Product team: workers and scheduling for the chat microservice, a refactor of organizations' last-access tracking with a dedicated index, bug fixes and RSpec tests.
experience_items.tech: Ruby on Rails · Sidekiq · PostgreSQL · RSpec
